Q8301.reason: Jure gestionis denotes non-sovereign acts a State performs in a private or commercial capacity, as opposed to jure imperii.

Q8305.reason: Foreign-judgment recognition is a private-international-law matter grounded in comity and judicial discretion, not treaty incorporation or transformation.

Q8317.reason: A brown irregular mass behind an intact tympanic membrane after chronic otitis media is the classic appearance of cholesteatoma, which is squamous epithelial proliferation.
